jsBridge: Custom `Shape`s plus `GeometryReader` sizing: compute the largest element that fits the offered space. It's the SwiftUI version of measuring a container with ResizeObserver and computing layout in JS.

compass.q: ResizeObserver + JS layout maths vs `GeometryReader`: which one re-runs on size changes automatically?

`GeometryReader` vs `Layout` protocol vs `containerRelativeFrame`: which for "fit N items in the space"?
